name: kurultay
description: Offline, multi-LLM coding agent: probes every configured model, indexes and summarizes the project, then completes tasks using all models concurrently (split / race / council).

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs cli
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs package
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all --coverage --min-lines=96 --min-branches=88 --min-functions=94
